title: WareAI
tagline: Revolutionizing warehouse management with an AI agent that optimizes inventory, predicts demand, automates workflows, and reduces costs. Smarter logistics, fewer errors, and faster fulfillment—all powered by AI.
description: Our AI-powered warehouse management tool optimizes inventory, automates order processing, and enhances efficiency with real-time tracking, smart routing, and demand forecasting. It reduces costs, minimizes errors, and integrates seamlessly with robotics and existing systems for faster, smarter logistics.
how_its_made:
We built the Warehouse Management AI Agent using AgentKit and Autonome, leveraging their modular AI agent framework for automation and real-time decision-making. The smart contract backbone is deployed on Base, ensuring secure, transparent, and efficient warehouse operations with on-chain integrations.

Tech Stack & Architecture:
AgentKit & Autonome: Used for developing and deploying autonomous AI agents that handle inventory tracking, demand forecasting, and order fulfillment automation.
Base Blockchain: Smart contracts deployed on Base enable secure tracking of inventory, order verification, and automated payments within the supply chain.
AI & ML: Trained models predict demand fluctuations, optimize warehouse layouts, and reduce order errors.
Gazebo Harmonic: Integrated for high-fidelity warehouse simulation, enabling AI agents to test and optimize robotic movements, storage efficiency, and automated fulfillment in a physics-accurate virtual environment.
